title: Warmth Drop
summary: Blankets, thermal layers and winter essentials for families facing cold conditions after displacement.
need: Families without safe, warm sleeping conditions who need winter essentials.

title: Hygiene Drop
summary: Soap, period products, nappies and basic hygiene packs delivered through a verified local partner.
need: Urgent hygiene support for families with limited access to essential supplies.

title: Food Drop
summary: Emergency food parcels or hot meals bought locally, where buying nearby is faster and more dignified.
need: Short-term food support for people affected by hardship, displacement or emergency conditions.

title: Shelter Drop
summary: Tents, tarps, bedding and household basics, only where a safe delivery route has been verified.
need: Temporary shelter for households who need immediate protection from exposure.
